questions.question: Christ died and returned to life for what reason?

answers.text: To be Lord of both the dead and the living
To settle every dispute over food
To make one day holier than the rest

questions.question: Why should believers stop judging or belittling a fellow believer?

answers.text: We will all stand before God's judgment seat
The apostles will sort it all out
Others will only judge us back

questions.question: How are believers told to accept a fellow believer whose faith is weak?

answers.text: Without passing judgment on his opinions
Only once his faith grows stronger

questions.question: Some believers eat differently and honor days differently. What are they told to pursue?

answers.text: What leads to peace and builds each other up
Whatever proves which side is right
Strict rules for every meal they share
